steps.what: Count stored product, compliance, or operational risks
Develop risk management strategies based on that assessment

tasks.design: The manager develops risk management strategies based on an assessment of product, compliance, or operational risks. {SPREADSHEET} only counts stored risk rows. A missing row is omitted and is not zero. The count does not rank a person or a product. The manager still develops the strategy, at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager counted the rows and wrote the strategy.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored risk rows can be counted. The strategy stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: What to do about a risk stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager rejects a count that treats a missing row as zero.
tasks.altitude: The count is clerical. The strategy stays at full effort.

reach.task: Hear the strategy the manager developed

evidence.claim: Stored risk rows can be counted. Developing the strategy stays manual. People and products are not scored.

assumptions: The work starts with the risk register and ends when the manager has set the strategy, or stops.
A risk row has identifier and kind, entered by the manager. A missing row is omitted and is not stored as zero. No person is named as a score.
The count does not choose the strategy.
unknowns: Which risks the manager records, and which a specialist records.
research_questions: How often was a risk row missing?

already_counted.description: Developing the strategy is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct a risk row before the count is used.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: rows are often missing, so the manager still builds the assessment. High: rows are complete, the count is shown, and the manager still develops the strategy. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise technical staff on environmental tools

steps.what: Advise technical professionals on environmental compliance tools
Advise them on development or use of reporting tools

tasks.design: The manager advises technical professionals on the development or use of environmental compliance or reporting tools. The advice stays at full effort. No product is chosen by a rule. The tool, if any, is one the organisation already runs.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager advised the technical staff.
tasks.still_hard: Which tool to use, and how, stays with the manager and the technical staff.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not recommend a tool they have not seen work.
tasks.altitude: The advice stays at full effort.

reach.task: Hear the advice from the manager

evidence.claim: Advising technical staff on an environmental reporting tool stays a conversation.

assumptions: The brief is the policy, case, or site the manager already holds. A blank field is left blank.
No employee, auditor, or caller is scored. Upkeep is zero.
The rules applied are those in force. No foreign filing process is invented.
unknowns: Which of these judgements the manager will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the manager stop rather than decide?

already_counted.description: This judgement is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the judgement adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every piece of advice is still given by the manager. High: the same conversation remains, with no tool chosen by a rule. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Conduct environmental audits on the site
Ensure adherence to environmental standards while on site

tasks.design: The manager conducts environmental audits to ensure adherence to environmental standards. The site work stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} walks the site or signs the audit.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager walked the site and wrote the audit.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the site adheres stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager stops when the condition is not the one the standard describes.
tasks.altitude: The audit stays at full effort and on site.

reach.task: Open the area the manager names
reach.learn: Which areas the manager could not enter.

evidence.claim: An environmental audit stays on site with the manager.

assumptions: The brief is the policy, case, or site the manager already holds. A blank field is left blank.
No employee, auditor, or caller is scored. Upkeep is zero.
The rules applied are those in force. No foreign filing process is invented.
unknowns: Which of these judgements the manager will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the manager stop rather than decide?

already_counted.description: This judgement is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the judgement adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every audit is still conducted by the manager. High: the same site work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Evaluate testing procedures against environmental monitoring programs
Check those procedures against the specifications the program states

tasks.design: The manager evaluates testing procedures to meet the specifications of environmental monitoring programs. The evaluation stays at full effort. A stored specification is not applied as a pass by a rule. The manager decides.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager read the procedure against the specification.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the procedure meets the specification stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not pass a procedure the specification does not cover.
tasks.altitude: The evaluation stays at full effort.

reach.task: Show the procedure the manager asks for

evidence.claim: Evaluating a testing procedure against a specification stays a judgement.

assumptions: The brief is the procedure and the specification the manager already holds.
A blank specification is left blank and is not invented. Upkeep is zero.
The rules are those in force. No employee is scored.
unknowns: Which of these judgements the manager will not delegate.
research_questions: How often did the manager stop rather than decide?

already_counted.description: This judgement is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the judgement adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every procedure is still evaluated by the manager. High: the same evaluation remains, with no pass issued by a rule. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The compliance manager still judges a breach, a sanction, and a policy change. A policy or a report is sent or filed only after the manager accepts that version.
reach: An employee reaches the manager directly with a confidential report.
A colleague receives only a policy the manager has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required flag, interval, or figure is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep investigations, sanctions, and policy changes in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every management report traces to a stored figure, and the manager still writes what it means.
